chapter.title: Hands on the Clock
chapter.subtitle: The staff handles the rush and the fade.
chapter.description: The staff handles the rush and the fade. Watch the film, work the shift, solve the House puzzle, and win a fade against the red and blue crews.

tips: Blue Titan brings a costly late support card. Take the middle and right districts before CLUE COOKY anchors the left.
Place the cook beside another ally so enemy ability damage can trigger retaliation.
The cook retaliates once per round; it is not an unlimited damage loop.
Round 1: Squabble House cook joins your hand. Round 2: Janitor joins your hand. These are temporary copies for this battle; pay their normal Motion costs to play them.

scenes.speaker: Security
scenes.text: You fit through it. Keep that option in mind.

scenes.speaker: Griddle
scenes.text: Hands on the clock! We still got orders up!

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: Not the plate. Cuff, keep it level. New shift—get the grill tickets moving.

scenes.speaker: Cuff

scenes.speaker: Griddle
scenes.text: One grill. Each pickup has a deadline. Finish the food by that minute; starting it then does not count.

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: No plate gets cold while these two rehearse being furniture.

puzzle.title: Keep the Pass Moving
puzzle.instruction: One grill. Start at minute 0. Cook one ticket at a time without interruption, using each ticket once. Each order must FINISH at or before its pickup deadline. Choose the sequence that gets all five out on time; waiting never helps.

pieces.label: Hash browns
pieces.detail: Cook time: 3 minutes. Pickup deadline: minute 10.

pieces.label: Toast
pieces.detail: Cook time: 1 minute. Pickup deadline: minute 11.

pieces.label: Waffle
pieces.detail: Cook time: 3 minutes. Pickup deadline: minute 5.

pieces.label: Eggs
pieces.detail: Cook time: 2 minutes. Pickup deadline: minute 2.

pieces.label: Bacon
pieces.detail: Cook time: 2 minutes. Pickup deadline: minute 7.

hints: The eggs need two minutes and must finish by minute two. Nothing can go before them.
After eggs finish at 2: waffle finishes at 5, bacon at 7, hash browns at 10, toast at 11. Any swap makes an order late.
puzzle.solvedText: Every pickup hits its deadline: 2, 5, 7, 10, 11. Griddle keeps the service moving while Security keeps Titan away from the hot pass.
puzzle.skipText: Let the crew explain the solution. The next fade still has to be won to earn its reward.
